metadata.name: Satellite World Simple Structure
metadata.description: Source-audited space catalog structure with explicit recorded decay, independent lifecycle and observation status, orbital elements, snapshot coverage, refresh health and unverified spacecraft profiles.
metadata.purpose: Model the observed fields and relationships in data/space/json with explicit source mappings.
sourceNotes: Structure inspected on 2026-09-26; source snapshots have different dates and coverage.
Classes describe record structures; individual satellite records remain external.
Hyperclasses group the diagram visually, without asserting v2 inheritance or membership.
GP metadata reports a failed refresh and degraded source status; diagram generation does not establish freshness.
Profile samples can contain placeholders; display association requires a curated mapping.
Tracking lifecycle, observation, and element availability are independent statuses.
The decayed feed covers 7,636 payload records, while tracked history has 35,570 decayed objects across several object types.
Decay feed counts.objects=7,478 counts name buckets; 43 buckets contain multiple distinct NORAD identities.
Fifty launch-date sidecar values disagree with the tracked catalog; original values are preserved.
OneWeb profile NORAD 44072 resolves to PRISMA; OneWeb and Starlink V1 profile launch dates disagree with catalog dates. Profile joins remain unverified.
TLE is a deprecated compatibility dataset. Configured debris GP groups have not been verified; tracked metadata uses active GP scope.
Source data audit and deliberate simplifications are documented in doc/SATELLITE_MODEL_SOURCES.md and doc/SPACE_DATA_AUDIT.json.

attributes.name: NORAD / Alpha-5 IDs
attributes.description: Use normalized positive decimal NORAD IDs as join keys; retain the optional Alpha-5 representation as an alias, not a second object identity.

attributes.name: Object ID
attributes.description: Internal obx:norad identifier; distinct from SATCAT OBJECT_ID.

attributes.name: Object type
attributes.description: Tracked taxonomy: PAYLOAD, DEBRIS, ROCKET_BODY, MISSION_RELATED, UNKNOWN; not all objects are satellites.

attributes.name: Radar cross-section
attributes.description: Nullable radar cross-section in square metres, not physical object size.

attributes.name: Feed / group tag
attributes.description: company can be ACTIVE: this is a source tag, not a verified operator company.

attributes.name: Launch date
attributes.description: Retain source-specific dates: 50 launch-date sidecar values disagree with tracked/SATCAT dates. Never merge by precedence without provenance.

attributes.name: Details / orbit flag
attributes.description: A launch record may have details only; its existence does not prove that orbital elements are available.

attributes.name: Operational / data status
attributes.description: tracked:operational_status; tracked:ops_status_code; tracked:data_status_code; satcat:OPS_STATUS_CODE; satcat:DATA_STATUS_CODE; gp:operational_status; launches:operational_status

attributes.name: Element epoch
attributes.description: TLE epoch remains encoded in tle_line1; no fabricated explicit TLE epoch field.

attributes.name: TLE line 1
attributes.description: GP snapshot has null TLE lines; OMM and TLE are alternative source representations.

attributes.name: Axis / altitude / frame
attributes.description: Distances explicitly suffixed _km use kilometres. The source orbit center/type codes remain separate from the derived orbit class.

attributes.name: Schema / revisions
attributes.description: Reported dataset/composite revisions are not automatically byte checksums of exported files.

attributes.name: Source lineage
attributes.description: tracked:@manifest.provenance; tracked:source; refresh:provider; refresh:source; refresh:source_url; refresh:source_urls; refresh:source_satcat_revision; refresh:source_gp_revision; refresh:source_gp_groups; refresh:last_reconciled_catalog_revision

attributes.name: Current / history scope
attributes.description: CURRENT/HISTORICAL are chunk scopes. Historical here contains decayed records, not a time-series event log; both scopes have catalog_membership_status PRESENT.

attributes.name: Chunks / quarantine
attributes.description: The supplied quarantine has zero rows; no rejected-record schema is invented.

attributes.name: Catalog ID / designator
attributes.description: Unverified references: the OneWeb profile ID 44072 resolves to PRISMA, and OneWeb / Starlink V1 launch dates conflict with catalog dates. Matching a numeric ID alone is insufficient.

attributes.name: Footprints
attributes.description: Optional GeoJSON-shaped profile field; sample/template values are not verified spacecraft telemetry.

attributes.name: Lifetime / inclination
attributes.description: Profile parameters are example/representative declarations, not verified catalog facts.

attributes.name: NORAD catalog ID
attributes.description: Join by positive decimal NORAD ID, never by the object-name bucket.

attributes.name: Recorded object type
attributes.description: decayed.json has PAY payloads only; tracked/SATCAT decay dates also cover debris, rocket bodies and unknown types.

attributes.name: Recorded decay date
attributes.description: Only nonempty recorded dates form a decay record. This is not a forecast, a timed reentry event, or evidence that all historical objects are in decayed.json.

attributes.name: Last attempt / success
attributes.description: An attempt timestamp does not establish a successful refresh.

attributes.name: Requested / verified scope
attributes.description: Configured debris groups are not verified coverage. Last-known-good GP catalog groups contain active only.

attributes.name: Format / compatibility
attributes.description: TLE metadata declares deprecated_compatibility=true; GP is the OMM source.

attributes.name: Reconcile counters
attributes.description: Retained_history counts in a derived feed are not tracked historical chunk counts. Decay counts.objects is the number of name buckets, not distinct NORAD IDs.

link.name: has
link.description: Observed NORAD joins: each feed has at most one row per ID in this snapshot; 50 launch-date sidecar values conflict with the tracked date. Across source revisions, retain multiple assertions.

sourceEvidence.joinRule: Positive decimal NORAD IDs as strings; preserve conflicting dates with their source.
sourceEvidence.scope: Observed supplied snapshots; not a universal HBDS constraint.

link.description: Unverified references: the OneWeb profile ID 44072 resolves to PRISMA, and OneWeb / Starlink V1 launch dates conflict with catalog dates. Matching a numeric ID alone is insufficient.

sourceEvidence.cardinality: 0..1 candidate by ID; not a verified association

link.name: contains
link.description: Nested profiles:payload object; profile/template values may be incomplete.

sourceEvidence.scope: Observed supplied snapshots; not a universal HBDS constraint.

link.name: use
link.description: Conceptual display association by curated profile/asset identity; no foreign-key field is supplied by the data.

sourceEvidence.joinRule: No foreign key links profiles to display assets; do not infer identity from a similar name.
sourceEvidence.scope: Observed supplied snapshots; not a universal HBDS constraint.

link.name: has
link.description: Per snapshot: one object has zero or one recorded decay date; one record refers to one NORAD identity. The same assertion may appear in several sources; do not count them as repeated physical decay events.

sourceEvidence.cardinality: 0..1 nonempty decay-date assertion per object per source snapshot
sourceEvidence.joinRule: Multiple feeds can repeat one assertion. Decayed.json is the payload subset; include other object types from tracked/SATCAT.
sourceEvidence.scope: Observed supplied snapshots; not a universal HBDS constraint.

link.name: is reported in
link.description: A decay assertion belongs to a source snapshot. Decayed feed: 7,636 payloads; tracked history: 35,570 objects. Preserve source-specific provenance.

sourceEvidence.cardinality: 1 source snapshot per assertion; an assertion can be repeated across sources
sourceEvidence.joinRule: Retain the owning file and revision; a grouping name is not an identity or event sequence.
sourceEvidence.scope: Observed supplied snapshots; not a universal HBDS constraint.

link.name: has
link.description: Each supplied dataset sidecar describes its latest attempt/result; there is no array of previous refresh events.

sourceEvidence.joinRule: Pair files with named metadata sidecars; no refresh-history records are supplied.
sourceEvidence.scope: Observed supplied snapshots; not a universal HBDS constraint.
